title: Oracle Morning Brief
script_summary:
Bitcoin slips 2.8% to 63,437 dollars as fear deepens, with the index at 29. Selling accelerated through Asian hours, pressuring price despite robust network metrics.

Hashrate holds at 879.8 EH/s and the mempool sits at 89,661 transactions with fees at one sat per vbyte. Block 959,957 confirms steady production.

Watch whether this fear reading sparks further downside or draws dip buyers today.
